The room is dimly lit by a soft window from the left, casting long warm-amber shadows on the desk surface and wrapping the back wall in the site's deep blue-grey tone (#1F2A36). A thin horizontal cyan rule (#5DBCE4) runs across the back wall, echoing the site's accent. The duck's silhouette is the canonical rounded body, slightly raised tail, flat base, two small forward-set webbed feet, small round head, wide flat beak, and a single side-set oval eye. The duck reads as a matte porcelain object, never glossy plastic. Color palette: cyan duck, deep blue-grey ambient, warm amber paper, near-white type at the margins. No prop noise. The duck owns the frame.
